forcing_mechanism.evidence: Employers with 150 to 249 workers must report pay gap data by 7 June 2027, and national law sets the fines.

findable.evidence: SIRENE and France Travail name French companies with NAF code and staff band; the catalogue lists no Spanish dataset.

early.evidence: SIRENE monthly files and live France Travail ads are available now, 8 months before the 7 June 2027 reporting date.

gap_evidence.evidence: France Travail ads carry a salaire field, but employers can also give pay information before the interview or otherwise.

crowding.evidence: Every payroll and HR vendor selling in the EU pitches pay gap reporting against the same 7 June 2027 date.

list_recipes.gap_evidence: none in the data; staff band shows exposure to the 7 June 2027 reporting duty only
list_recipes.metric: staff band and months left before 7 June 2027
list_recipes.caveat: SIRENE shows exposure, not inaction, and its 100-199 band mixes 2027 reporters with 2031 reporters.

list_recipes.filter: codeNAF 55, 56, 47 or 41-43; trancheEffectifEtab 10-249; dateCreation after 7 June 2026
list_recipes.gap_evidence: salaire field empty or with no amount or range
list_recipes.metric: share of the company's open ads with no salary amount or range
list_recipes.caveat: Employers can give pay information before the interview or otherwise, so an ad without salary does not prove non-compliance.
